abilities.name: Runic Flare
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by a melee attack action but before the hit rolls are made. Count up to 2 critical hits from that attack action as hits instead.

abilities.name: Kyndlebreath
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 6" of this fighter and roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability. For each roll of a 5+, allocate 1 damage point to that fighter and to each other visible enemy fighter within 2" of that fighter.

abilities.name: Blazing Impetus
abilities.text: A fighter can use this abilities only after making two move actions in the same activation. This fighter makes a bonus move action or a bonus disengage action.

abilities.name: Ignite Weapon
abilities.text: Count 1 miss from the next attack action made by this fighter this activation as a critical hit instead.

abilities.name: Berserk Rampage
abilities.text: Pick an enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter and roll 6 dice. For each result that matches the value of this ability, allocate a number of damage points to that enemy fighter equal to the value of this ability For each other result, allocate 1 damage point to that fighter.

abilities.name: Creed of Flame
abilities.text: Pick a friendly fighter that is not within 6" of this fighter. That fighter makes 2 bonus move actions or a bonus attack action. If that friendly fighter has the Beast runemark, that fighter makes 2 bonus move actions, then a bonus attack action

abilities.name: Aspect of the Scale
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 3" of this fighter and roll 6 dice. For each roll of 2+, allocate a number of damage points to that fighter equal to half the value of this ability (rounding up).

abilities.name: Vulkyn Flameseekers
abilities.text: Friendly fighters with the Berseker runemark can use the following ability:[Triple] Reborn in Flame:Pick a friendly fighter with the Beast runemark that has been taken down. Set that fighter up on a platform or the battlefield floor wholly within 3" of this fighter. That fighter no longer counts as being taken down. Remove each damage point allocated to that fighter.
